title: Police Investigate Woman's Murder in Gurgaon, Suspect's Confession Raises Questions
summary: A woman was found murdered in her home in Gurgaon, and the suspect, her husband, has made a confession that raises questions about his involvement. The police are investigating the case, which has sparked concerns about domestic violence and the role of girlfriends in such incidents.
summary_points: A woman was found murdered in her home in Gurgaon
The suspect, her husband, has made a confession that raises questions about his involvement
The police are investigating the case, which has sparked concerns about domestic violence
The suspect's confession includes details about his relationship with the victim and his alibi for the time of the murder
The investigation is ongoing, and authorities are working to determine the circumstances surrounding the woman's death

summary_hi: गुरुग्राम में एक महिला की हत्या की गई, और उसके पति, जो हत्यारा था, ने एक खुले कबूलने किया है जिससे सवाल उठते हैं। पुलिस इस मामले की जांच कर रही है, जिससे घरेलू हिंसा और शादी में लड़कफ्रेंड की भूमिका से संबंधित चिंताएं उत्पन्न हुई हैं
